integrity.computational_scope: 1832 bounded algebraic and direct Liouvillian checks; finite checks do not prove the universal theorem
integrity.originality_scope: source-by-source classification comparison, not a claim of exhaustive publication-priority verification
integrity.proof_basis: exact stationary Lindblad linear system, rational factorization and strict sign inequalities

scientific_limitations: Restricted to the exact stationary state of the resonant Markovian repeated-collision single-qubit generator with positive composite couplings and finite positive temperature.
Ancilla-cluster sizes are physical integers; the continuous minima and bath crossover need not fall in an observable integer interval.
Purely unitary single-qubit ergotropy is not net charging efficiency once collision-switching work is included.
Existing full closed-form stationary Bloch solutions are prior art; the precise analytic purity/entropy sign classification may be implied by broader unknown literature.
title: Exact purity turnarounds and a Bose–Fermi entropy crossover in a coherent qubit battery
